assertions.name: d_frame_routes_land_both_targets
assertions.source: Coherence count over all 5 physical Convention-D bar(z_D) = z_D - h evaluations (D1_z_D_even_iso, D2_z_D_cumulant_sym_iso, D2_z_D_minus_h_writhe, D3_z_D_odd_half_h_writhe, D3_z_D_odd_half_h_iso): Route D1 (z_D^{even} = z_D - h/2 = 0.508158, ISO), Route D2 (1/2(b_A(z_D)+b_A(z_D-h)), ISO and WRITHE barred branch z_D-h), and Route D3 (z_D^{odd} = h/2 = 0.104530, WRITHE and ISO). Every route misses the strong targets {3.8128, 13.0316} by >20% against the 5% gate.

assertions.name: single_m_lands_both_targets
assertions.source: Coherence count over the branches examined (writhe_fix_rho4, iso_bareven_fix_rho4). Each candidate m lands ONE target exactly by construction of the bisection that produced it, and each rho is monotone in m on its branch, so these are the only m that can land both. WRITHE at rho4=T4 gives rho3 off -35.3%; ISO bar-even at rho4=T4 (m=0.31900, all dets positive, so NOT excluded on physicality as the old note claimed) gives rho3_even off -9.9%; WRITHE rho3=T3 has no root at all in the physical window. Gate: 5%, matching writhe_forced_rho3_misses_target_gt5pct.

description: Vector-3 forward test: bar-even symmetrization of the b_A=-ln det(I+mG) cumulant does NOT crack the isospin-even strong binding magnitude. Evaluated in both C-frame (g_reeb, z_naive bar-even => structural no-op) and canonical Convention D via bar(z_D) = 1/(q^3+q) = z_D - h (z_D = z_D^{even} + h/2, routes D1/D2/D3, bean qou-pmkh / Q-WXHI-2 = 1), plus a free-m steelman coherence scan: no parameter-free or free m lands both isospin-corrected strong targets {3.81, 13.03}. Honest negative, scope-(a) + scope-(b) sub-result. No fit, audit-only.
tier: structural (exact det closed forms + C/D bar-parity argument; no fit, no AME inversion)

bar_parity_of_parameter_free_magnitude.consequence: m(q^-1)=m(q) => b_A(q)=b_A(q^-1) for every A at g_reeb and z_C => bar-even symmetrization is a STRUCTURAL NO-OP on those bar-even magnitudes.

d_frame_bar_parity_decomposition.reading: Under canonical Convention D, z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) is bar-NEITHER: bar(z_D) = 1/(q^3+q) = z_D - h, so z_D = z_D^{even} + z_D^{odd} with z_D^{even} = z_D - h/2 = 0.508158 and z_D^{odd} = +h/2 = 0.104530. Across all three D-frame routes (D1: m = z_D^{even}; D2: 1/2(b_A(z_D)+b_A(z_D-h)); D3: m = z_D^{odd} = h/2 symmetrized), 0 of 5 physical evaluations land both strong targets {3.8128, 13.0316} within 5%.

algebraic_preflight.reading: A=4 writhe det=(1-5m^2)(1-m^2) is even in m (symmetric spectrum {+-sqrt5,+-1}) => b_4 bar-even regardless of magnitude parity; the iso det carries odd-in-m terms (A>=3).

isospin_corrected_strong_targets.method: Lean #3986: strong 3H/3He split=0 => 3H(Z=1,no pp pair) IS the strong A=3 value => rho_strong(3)=B(3H)/BD=3.813 (the task's 3.6 is the naive symmetric average, which is physically incorrect since only 3He carries Coulomb). 4He: add pp-Coulomb E_C4=E_C3He*(3/4)^{1/3} back => 13.03.

writhe_fix_rho3.note: rho3_writhe is monotone DECREASING in m and capped below the target over the whole physical window m < 1/sqrt5 -- no m lands rho3=T3 at all, so there is nothing to force rho4 to.

iso_raw_rho4_range.note: rho4 monotone in (~3,~6); cannot reach strong target 13.03

iso_bareven_unphysical_at.note: rho3_even stalls near 3.4 against the 3.813 target.  (The old note here also claimed det(I-mS) turns negative BEFORE rho4_even reaches 13.03.  It does not -- see iso_bareven_fix_rho4: the target is reached at m=0.31900 with every det still positive.)

iso_bareven_fix_rho4.note: rho4_even hits the strong A=4 target while all three dets stay positive, so this branch is NOT excluded on physicality -- it is excluded because rho3_even misses.

verdict.classification: HONEST NEGATIVE (scope-(a)) with a scope-(b) sub-result.
verdict.scope_b_subresult: The parameter-free bond magnitude g_reeb (and C-frame z_C) is bar-even AND the A=4 writhe cumulant det is even in m (Lean B4CumulantBarEven.lean) => bar-even symmetrization is a structural no-op at the dominant A=4 magnitude wall; under canonical Convention D, bar(z_D) = 1/(q^3+q) = z_D - h decomposes z_D into z_D^{even} = z_D - h/2 and z_D^{odd} = +h/2 (bean qou-pmkh).
verdict.scope_a_negative: No single parameter-free (C-frame, D-frame bar-decomposed, or even free) m reproduces BOTH isospin-corrected strong ratios {3.81, 13.03}: under D, Route D1 (z_D^{even}=0.508158) is above the WRITHE ceiling and gives ISO rho3=2.40342 (-36.96%), rho4=4.02653 (-69.10%); Route D2 (1/2(b_A(z_D)+b_A(z_D-h))) gives ISO rho3=2.37349 (-37.75%), rho4=3.94745 (-69.71%) and WRITHE barred-branch rho3=2.48536 (-34.82%), rho4=10.476 (-19.61%); Route D3 (z_D^{odd}=h/2=0.104530) gives WRITHE rho3=3.03383 (-20.43%), rho4=6.11363 (-53.09%) and ISO rho3=3.03383 (-20.43%), rho4=6.21100 (-52.34%). In the free-m steelman scan, WRITHE rho4=13.03 forces rho3=2.466 (-35.3%); WRITHE rho3=3.81 has no root at all (rho3_writhe caps at 2.91 < 3.81); ISO raw rho4 caps at ~6; ISO bar-even reaches rho4=13.03 at m=0.31900 (all dets > 0), where rho3_even is 3.435 (-9.9%).
verdict.consistency: Consistent with (not a re-derivation of) the 2026-06-25 scope-(b) pruning that 4He binding must be bar-even; here the b_A cumulant is shown to be ALREADY bar-even at g_reeb/z_C and non-rescuing across all three Convention-D bar(z_D) = z_D - h routes, so the overshoot is a genuine bar-even magnitude problem. Nothing wired, no fit, no AME inversion.
